programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Wife Visits
programme.desc: Divorce looms over Dangle and his estranged wife, and the rest of the department struggles with a giant Ten Commandments monument.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Religion in Reno
programme.desc: The Reverend Gigg LeCarp, Reno's favorite televangelist, saves the deputies in their very own jail.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fire Fighters Are Jerks
programme.desc: The accursed Fire Department schedules its Pancake Dinner at the same time as the Policeman's Ball.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Not Without My Mustache
programme.desc: As the deputies struggle to save their moustaches from a county-ordered shave, Jones worries about a psychic's prediction.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Security for Kenny Rogers
programme.desc: Deputy Garcia lives his lifelong dream: leading security for a Kenny Rogers book signing.

programme.title: RENO 911!: More FBI Help
programme.desc: When the lieutenant governor's brother goes missing, the FBI swings in to help the deputies.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Raineesha X
programme.desc: Williams discovers the Nation of Islam and changes her ways, while Clemmy and Dangle throw down at a fraternity costume contest.

programme.title: The Roast of Alec Baldwin

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Day 2
programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. Aftenens gæstedommere er Whoopi Goldberg og Anthony Jeselnik.

programme.title: The Roast of William Shatner
programme.desc: The Roast of William Shatner blev nomineret til en Primetime Emmy Award i 2007. Afsnittet placerer skuespilleren William Shatner i den varme stol, mens Roastmasteren Jason Alexander og en bred vifte af komikere får ham ned med nakken.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: What's in the Box
programme.desc: A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Masks
programme.desc: A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programme.desc: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon, Mustafa, Malia, and Kevin engage in a roundtable discussion highlighting their most shocking finds and new data that they’ve gathered across their numerous investigations.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Lisa Rinna, Jeffrey Ross, Vincent Curatola, Illeana Douglas
programme.desc: Lisa Rinna's family is haunted by a lonely ghost seeking a family of her own; Vincent Curatola rediscovers his mother's love after she dies.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Carnie Wilson, Eric Roberts, Elisabeth Rohm, C. Thomas Howell
programme.desc: Carnie Wilson meets the ghost of a drunken barber from the 1890s; Eric Roberts has an out-of-body experience after a car wreck.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Justine Bateman, Traci Lords, Jay Thomas, James Kyson Lee
programme.desc: A spirit makes Justine Bateman's life a lot merrier; Jay Thomas mistakenly uses stones taken from a tombstone for a home renovation and pays a price.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: P.S.
programme.desc: En nyligt skilt kvinde får muligheden for at genopleve sin fortid, da hun møder en ung mand, der tilsyneladende er hendes gymnasie kæreste, der døde mange år tidligere.

programme.title: Wonder Wheel
programme.desc: ”Wonder Wheel” er historien om fire menneskers liv, der flettes sammen i en charmerende og travl forlystelsespark på Coney Island.

programme.title: Bare Juliet
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er kørt træt i sit parforhold med Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), der er kæmpefan af musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Da en demoversion af Tuckers gamle hit LP dukker op, bliver det starten på et nyt møde med den flyvske kunstner.

programme.title: My Better Halves
programme.desc: Kriminalforfatteren Charles har skriveblokering. I jagten på inspiration beder han spiritisten Madame Arcati lave en seance. Det fører til mere end forventet, da Madame Arcati fremmaner genfærdet af Charles' kone, Elvira, der vil genoptage sit liv.

programme.title: Ernest Rides Again
programme.desc: I denne skøre komedie finder den klovneagtige Ernest P. Worrell og hans tumpede ven Abner en kæmpe kanon, der siges at indeholde Englands kronjuveler. Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: Three hapless guys are mistaken for Army Reservists and loaded onto an army plane headed for Iraq and then mistakenly ejected in a Humvee somewhere over Mexico.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: Fjern, så tæt! er en tysk fantasy-film fra 1993 instrueret af Wim Wenders. Manuset er af Wenders, Richard Reitinger og Ulrich Zieger. Det er en efterfølger til Wenders 'film Wings of Desire fra 1987.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson er tilbage som den tidligere CIA-agent Bryan Mills, der er ved at blive forsonet med sin ekskone, da hun bliver brutalt myrdet. Mills bliver beskyldt for mordet og tager flugten optændt af raseri og med CIA, FBI og politiet i hælene.

programme.title: The Con is On
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at slippe for at betale en gigantisk spillegæld, flygter Harriet og Peter til Hollywood. Planen er, at infiltrere et juvelrøveri som involverer Peters eks-kone.

programme.title: The Prince
programme.desc: Den pensionerede forbryderkonge og enlige far Paul, tvinges til at vende tilbage til Las Vegas og det kriminelle samfund, da hans datter kidnappes.

programme.title: Mutant X: I nærvær af mine fjender
programme.desc: Jesse forelsker sig i en computerhacker, som Eckhart ønsker at "skaffe" for at korrumpere de offentlige computernyhedskanaler mod de nye mutanter.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Tak skal du have
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel tager til Tyskland for at finde en forsvunden Elvis Presley-guitar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Transformation
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og Derek Lloyd tager til den peruvianske jungle for at lede efter Paracelsus-rullerne, som indeholder formlen til at forvandle bly til guld.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Flagdag
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel tager til Larivee i Californien for at finde pionerens bjørneflag.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kejserens brud
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i Alaska for at finde den hvide jadesarkofag fra en kinesisk kejserinde. Sydney støder på sine kolleger Dallas Carter og Kurt Reiner, der også er på jagt efter relikvier.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine and Garcia are Dating
programme.desc: After getting it on with nearly every other man in Reno, Johnson finally hooks up with Garcia, and Dangle breaks out his chimney sweep costume.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover Drug Bust
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia enjoy their undercover stakeout a little too much, and Dangle and Clemmy start the department's first rock band.

programme.title: RENO 911!: President Bush in Reno
programme.desc: Reno's finest take on traffic control for President George W. Bush's motorcade, and Jones and Garcia reenact the Civil War at a pizza parlor.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Accidental Marriage

programme.title: RENO 911!: Milkshake Man's Death

programme.title: RENO 911!: Investigation Concluded

programme.title: RENO 911!: Released from Prison
programme.desc: Members of the Reno Sheriff's Department start new lives after getting kicked off the force.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Revenge of Mike Powers

programme.title: RENO 911!: Cop School
programme.desc: Some promising new recruits intimidate the team with their skills, and Wiegel has trouble making magic with her incarcerated boyfriend.

programme.title: The Roast of Charlie Sheen

programme.title: Jeff Ross Roasts Criminals

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Live Finals
programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. I aftenens live finale er gæstedommerne Sarah Silverman og Judd Apatow.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programme.desc: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Diane Farr
programme.desc: Actress Diane Farr (Numb3rs, Private Practice) fears that a ghost is causing unexplained havoc in her California home.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Loni Love
programme.desc: Comedienne Loni Love returns to the hotel in Winston-Salem, North Carolina where she had an experience so terrifying, she fled in the middle of the night.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Lou Gossett Jr.
programme.desc: Academy award-winning actor Louis Gossett Jr. anxiously returns to the hotel in Louisiana where angry spirits surrounded him over 30 years ago.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Jonathan Bennett
programme.desc: Actor Jonathan Bennett (Mean Girls, All My Children) has been sensing a dark spirit in his new home, where all of his electronics seem to have minds of their own.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: The Lunchbox

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Carl Reiner (The Jerk) instruerede denne historie om John Candy som en familiefar, der tager en pause fra sund fornuft, når han lejer et sommerhus i Florida.

programme.title: Mit hjem i Hampstead
programme.desc: 'Mit hjem i Hampstead' er en sjov og livsbekræftende feelgood-film om, at kærligheden findes de mest uventede steder og beviser én gang for alle, at alder ikke er en hindring for at starte helt forfra.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: Mens Jack Deebs sad i fængsel, fandt han en måde at slippe derfra ved at skabe Cool World, en tegneserie med en smuk kvinde ved navn Holli Would. Kødet viser sig dog at være svagere end blæk, da Holli tager menneskeform i Las Vegas.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk pigeskole i hjertet af Chicago, byen som er hjem for USA's mest populære danseshow: Dance TV! Udvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrag, da hun bliver præsenteret for sine fnisende klassekammerater.

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlægger finder kærligheden, da hun arbejder med at arrange det sidste bryllup på et historisk værtshus.

programme.title: Eye in the Sky
programme.desc: Helen Mirren, Aaron Paul og Alan Rickman medvirker i denne politiske spændingsfilm. Ved en militæroperation har man chancen for at dræbe tre fremtrædende terrorister, men etikken komplicerer tingene.

programme.title: Andromeda: En rose i asken

programme.title: Andromeda: Hele Neptuns store hav

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et høytsvevende liv. Han flyr over hele verden på forretningsreiser og er stadig på farten. Men så treffer han medpassasjeren Alex og lærer at livet ikke handler om reisen, men kontaktene man oppnår langs veien.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: Wild Rose
programme.desc: En ung Glasgow-jente drømmer om å bli countrystjerne i Nashville.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: En kvinne flytter inn i et nabolag der en gruppe ektemenn har gjort konene sine til roboter som er designet for å ta vare på dem. Nyinnspilling av filmen fra 1975.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere agenten Bryan Mills begynner de lengste 96 timene i sitt liv når han tar opp jakten på mennene som kidnappet datteren hans.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Them
programme.desc: Engang var Conor og Eleanor lykkelig gift. Nå føler de seg fremmed for hverandre, og i kjølevannet av en tragisk hendelse lengter de etter å finne tilbake til det liv og den kjærligheten de engang hadde.

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: Pee-Wee Herman er en enkel bonde i en liten by. Men plutselig kommer en kraftig storm. Et sirkus ender opp på Pee-Wees gård. Så han lar sirkuset bli der en stund, og det bestemmer seg for å lage et show med en elskverdig figur: Pee-Wee!

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Transformation
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og Derek Lloyd drar til den peruanske jungelen for å lete etter Paracelsus-rullene som inneholder formelen for å gjøre bly til gull.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Flag Day
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Larivee, California for å finne Pioneer's Bear Flag.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Emperor's Bride
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i Moose Bay, Alaska på jakt etter den hvite jadesarkofagen til en kinesisk keiserinne. Sydney støter på andre relikviejegere Dallas Carter og Kurt Reiner.

programme.title: Andromeda: En rose i asken
programme.desc: Dylan er fengslet på en fengselsplanet og må utføre en flukt mens mannskapet hans prøver å redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Alle store Neptuns hav
programme.desc: Castalian styrer Andromeda for å fullføre charteret for det nye samveldet. Når lederen blir oppdaget død, er Tyr hovedmistenkt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Heist
programme.desc: In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Bounty Hunters / School Test / Going Down
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head become ace bounty hunters after a chance meeting with a reality TV. / With a big test looming, our favorite idiots receive an education in cheating. / Beavis and Butt-Head find themselves trapped in an elevator with a smokin hot chick

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Oil Change / Whiplash
programme.desc: After being instructed to change the oil in the fryer at Burger World, Beavis and Butt-head get the oil from a local gas station. / In an attempt to collect some big insurance money, Butt-head tries to give Beavis a whiplash injury while riding the school

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Candy Sale / To the Rescue
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head sell chocalate bars for their school. Well, the chocolate bars practically sell themselves. / Beavis and Butt-head witness a plane crash and appear in a cheesy reenactment on "Rescue 911."

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Stewart is Missing / Yard Sale
programme.desc: Mrs. Stevenson shows up at Butt-head's house, desperate to enlist their help in finding Stewart. / Tom Anderson get Beavis and Butt-head to watch his yard sale, and the boys manage to sell everything when they take the sale inside.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Tainted Meat / Bad Dog
programme.desc: Beavis and his bacteria ridden "thingy" contaminate the food at Burger World. / Beavis and Butt-head adopt a vicious dog at a shelter and it trains them.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Crisis line / Career day
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head set out to support callers on a crisis line / Later they go out on work experience as security guards

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A Very Special Episode / Dumbasses Anonymous
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head come to the aid of a wounded baby bird...almost. / Beavis and Butt-head show up at an AA meeting hoping to score some booze.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Nektet service / Balleskvis
programme.desc: Beavis prøver yogabukser og får dem ikke av. / Guttene oppdager at de har rett til å nekte service til kunder på Burger World.

programme.title: RENO 911!: More FBI Help
programme.desc: When the lieutenant governor's brother goes missing, the FBI swings in to help the deputies.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Raineesha X
programme.desc: Williams discovers the Nation of Islam and changes her ways, while Clemmy and Dangle throw down at a fraternity costume contest.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine and Garcia are Dating
programme.desc: After getting it on with nearly every other man in Reno, Johnson finally hooks up with Garcia, and Dangle breaks out his chimney sweep costume.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover Drug Bust
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia enjoy their undercover stakeout a little too much, and Dangle and Clemmy start the department's first rock band.

programme.title: RENO 911!: President Bush in Reno
programme.desc: Reno's finest take on traffic control for President George W. Bush's motorcade, and Jones and Garcia reenact the Civil War at a pizza parlor.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Accidental Marriage
programme.desc: Garcia shoots a Dungeons & Dragons player, and Junior accidentally gets married during a sting operation.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Milkshake Man's Death
programme.desc: Reno District Attorney Mike Powers investigates the Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Investigation Concluded
programme.desc: District Attorney Mike Powers concludes his investigation of the Sheriff's Department, while Terry the prostitute takes off in Reno's police helicopter.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 1
programme.desc: The Office of Homeland Security teaches the Reno Sheriff's Department terrorist attack protocol, and Clemmy's mom gets into trouble.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 2
programme.desc: The Reno Sherriff's Department passes their Homeland Security exam with flying colors, and Clemmy and a drunk driver discover some new moves.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Obsolete Man
programme.desc: In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Quality of Mercy
programme.desc: A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Still Valley
programme.desc: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: I etterkant av av en verdensomspennende atomkrig er Ann Burden (Margot Robbie) en overlevende. Ann frykter lenge at hun er det eneste gjenlevende mennesket på jorden, inntil hun oppdager noe helt forbløffende: et annen menneske.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of Difference
programme.desc: Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.

programme.desc: En erfaren lönnmördare får problem när han blir kär i sitt mål, en charmig svindlare som inte tänker gå ner utan en fight.

programme.title: Gasoline Alley
programme.desc: Jimmy Jayne har suttit i fängelse och är nu huvudmisstänkt för ett brutalt massmord i Hollywood och han skyr inga medel för att bevisa sin oskuld.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-experten Friar hittar en bomb med tryckkänslig utlösare under sin skrivbordsstol och en osynlig hackare tvingar honom att stjäla digitala medel på nätet – för annars kommer Friars dotter att föras bort.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: När Jack Deebs var bakom galler fann han verklighetsflykt genom att skapa Cool World, en tecknad serie om en ragata som heter Holli Would. Köttet är dock svagare än bläcket, då Holli tar mänsklig form i Las Vegas.

programme.title: Mutant X: Kropp och själ
programme.desc: En mutant tar över olika människors kroppar och ger sig ut för att jaga dem som gjorde det här mot honom. En av dem är en läkare som Shalimar gillar.

programme.title: Mutant X: Understudy
programme.desc: Under ett jobb skadas Shalimar och får hjälp av en annan vild mutant, Nikki, som hon kände och som nästan valdes ut till teamet. Medan Shalimar återhämtar sig erbjuder hon sig att hoppa in.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Springa Sydney, Springa
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel hamnar i ett bakhåll i Ryssland. Två veckor senare vaknar Sydney upp i huset hos en man som heter Tsarlov, som påstår sig ha räddat henne.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fransk anslutning
programme.desc: Under en föreläsningsturné med Nigel i Europa blir Sydney kontaktad av MI5 eftersom hon är den enda som kan förhindra ett förestående lönnmord på hög nivå.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Gå inte in i skogen
programme.desc: Sydneys vän ringer för att berätta att han har hittat information om Maribors gyllene hök, som varit försvunnen sedan 1711. Sydney och Nigel reser till Lubjanka för att träffa honom, men han är redan borta.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Ghoul

programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: The Deep Blue Sea

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Naughty But Niece
programme.desc: Bud is distracted by Marcy's sexy niece.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Business Sucks

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Business Still Sucks
programme.desc: Al's battle against breastfeeding lands him in trouble with the store's owner.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Dial B For Virgin

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Sleepless In Chicago
programme.desc: Al must sleep with Marcy so that Jefferson can cash in her valuable Barbie doll.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: No Pot To Pease In
programme.desc: The Bundys and D'Arcys discover a new TV show modeled after their lives.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Sporting goods / Cow tipping
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head decide to get athletic gear supporters for gym class / The duo venture out on a quest for cow tipping

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Give Blood / Beware of the Butt (aka Drive-In #1)
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Scared Straight / Citizen Butt-head Part 2
programme.desc: To teach them that crime doesn't pay, Beavis & Butt-head's principal sends them to prison for a day. Bad idea. / Beavis & Butt-head and President Clinton explore chaos theory together.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Murder Site / Sexual Harassment
programme.desc: Beavis can't take Butt-head's verbal abuse anymore, and snaps while they're checking out the site of a local murder. / Beavis and Butt-head sue Kimberly for sexual harassment, since she's giving them wood.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Take a number / Stewart moves away / Premature evacuation
programme.desc: The duo goes to rock concert / Beavis and Butt-Head breaks into Stewarts house to watch TV / A bomb threat is called into their high school

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Butt-Head blir snäll / Hemhjälpen
programme.desc: Butt-Head får medicin för sin aggressivitet mot Beavis och blir lite för snäll./ Medelålders Beavis och Butt-Head får slut på ölpengar, så Beavis måste skaffa ett jobb.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Radio Sweethearts / The Great Cornholio
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head win a radio contest and become disc jockeys for a day. / During a sugar rush, Beavis' alter ego appears. He reeks havoc at Highland High looking for "teepee for his bunghole."

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Car Wash / Kidnapped
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head attempt to make some money washing cars. / Beavis & Butt-head decide that kidnapping Stewart would be a quick way to some cash.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clemmy Marries a Dead Guy
programme.desc: Johnson tries to marry the late Hot Tub King of Reno, and Garcia and Williams discover the magical properties of Liberace's piano.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Secret Girlfriend
programme.desc: Dangle and the gang solve Reno's biggest mystery: who is Garcia's new girlfriend?

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Son
programme.desc: While Dangle spends time with a beautiful young man who might be his son, the other deputies enjoy the new department Humvee.

programme.title: RENO 911!: CSI: Reno
programme.desc: The deputies work as security guards when "CSI: Miami" comes to Reno, and Wiegel and Dangle get a homeless man into a bathtub.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Naked Stake-Out
programme.desc: After a drug sting goes wrong, Dangle and Junior race back to the station on foot -- and naked.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel and Craig Get Married
programme.desc: Good news and bad news for Wiegel: her boyfriend proposed, but he's going to be executed for multiple murders.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Pregnant
programme.desc: Did Dangle and Garcia freeze to death? Did Wiegel's serial killer husband get lethally injected? What is Carrot Top doing in Reno, and why is he so mad?

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Junior Bros.
programme.desc: While Garcia goes undercover to bust undocumented workers and the people who hire them, Junior spends his day off with his brothers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jet Ski Blues
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Prime Mover
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler cajoles his friend to use his telekinesis to affect the results of the gambling tables in Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programme.desc: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
programme.desc: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
programme.desc: Following a frantic phone call about a crashed spaceship, two policemen try and determine who among the passengers of a bus at a snowed-in roadside diner is from another world.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust
programme.desc: In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The One I Love
programme.desc: Ett par i kris försöker rädda sitt förhållande på en helgresa.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris är en ung, vacker men pank tennistränare som blir involverad i en rik familj genom att träna en av familjemedlemmarna. Kärleksaffärer med två kvinnor samtidigt tvingar honom att begå ett allvarligt brott.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Striden börjar när den heroiska Leonidas, endast beväpnad med läderunderkläder och en bortkastad mantel, leder en brokig skara på 13 (ja, 13!) krigare för att försvara sitt hemland.

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Jaques (Brian Cox – THE BOURNE IDENTITY) äger en sjaskig bar, som fungerar som ett andra hem för en brokig skara professionella drinkare. Jaques själv är fast besluten att supa och röka sig till döds. När han möter den unge hemlöse Lucas…

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: När en amerikansk stad invaderas av nordkoreanska soldater, går en grupp ungdomar tillsammans för att skydda varandra, befria staden och återta sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Bryan Mills och hans fru är i Istanbul när de blir kidnappade. Mannen som håller dom som gisslan visar sig vara far till en av de män som tidigare kidnappat Mills dotter, och som han under fritagandet av dottern dödat.

programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: En mycket begåvad film som bland annat prisbelönats för Bästa regi i Cannes 1987. Damiel (Bruno Ganz) är en ensam ängel som strövar omkring på Berlins krigsmärkta gator och tröstar dödliga i nöd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Var alla mina synder ihåg
programme.desc: En identifiering av en kropp går snett när det visar sig att Bekas tidigare besättningskamrat inte är död.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Grift
programme.desc: Brennans skumma före detta flickvän vänder sig till honom för att få hjälp när hennes senaste bluff tar en dödlig vändning.

programme.title: Mutant X: Vid ödets slut
programme.desc: Teamet står inför sitt farligaste uppdrag hittills: att stoppa en grupp ekoterrorister.

programme.title: Mutant X: Inom dessa väggar

programme.title: Mutant X: Hard Time
programme.desc: Teamet går under täckmantel för att undersöka oförklarliga dödsfall i ett fängelse.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The Frighteners
programme.desc: Life has changed drastically for thunder buddies John (Mark Wahlberg), now a bachelor, and best pal Ted (Seth MacFarlane), now married to the woman (Jessica Barth) of his dreams. Problems arise when the couple decide to adopt a child, but the law declares Ted to be property and not a person. Angry and dejected, the lovably foulmouthed teddy bear must now seek legal help from a young lawyer (Amanda Seyfried) and a legendary, civil-rights attorney (Morgan Freeman) to get the justice he deserves.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: A Bucket of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
